question: Which of the following article of Indian Constitution ensures the protection of minority interests?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 29**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Article 29** of the **Indian Constitution** ensures the **protection of interests of minorities**. It provides any section of the citizens with a distinct language, script, or culture the right to conserve the same.

• This article guarantees that the state shall not deny admission into educational institutions maintained by it or receiving aid from it on the grounds of religion, race, caste, language, or any of them.

• **Article 29(1):** Protects the rights of any group of citizens to conserve their distinct language, script, or culture.
